groups.label: Talent
groups.blurb: Draft capital, points per touch, and last year's production.

groups.label: Role
groups.blurb: Share of his team's work, work that's opened up (departures, injuries), depth chart spot, new team, and recent usage trend.

groups.label: Age & experience
groups.blurb: Rookie / year-2 / year-3 jumps and age relative to the position's peak.

groups.label: Starting level
groups.blurb: How high his current per-game level already is. Already-elite players have little room to break out.
